implementation.recursive_split_tree: Validated allowlisted dock-tree model with bounded splits, ratios and active-tab normalization; renderer mounts existing Editor panel elements into DOM split/tab zones and restores their original DOM locations at breakpoints.
implementation.interaction: Keyboard and pointer split resizing, keyboard tab activation, Alt+arrow reflow and desktop detach/regroup are backed by the shared workspace history and allowlisted persistence.
implementation.canvas_safety: Floating card presentation remains within its separately reserved dock track; the workspace canvas is not covered and retains its tested minimum width.
implementation.save_publish: Workspace-only layout operations do not write the page model or call the page Save/Publish endpoints. Editor content Save and explicit Publish remain separate paths.
implementation.reuse_and_cost: Reuses the project's existing Page Model boundary, workspace appearance store, dock panel DOM, Node test runner, Playwright/Chromium and CSS grid. No external source, dependency, D1 mutation, R2 operation or paid service was added; cost 0 Ft.
